About The Opportunity
Job Type: Permanent
Application Deadline: 31 January 2027
Title
Technical Consultant – Enterprise Network Security Services
Department
Enterprise Network & Multimedia Services
Location
Dalian
Reports To
Senior Technical Manager – Enterprise Network Security Services
Level
Grade 5
Fidelity International offers world class investment solutions and retirement expertise. As a privately owned, independent company, investment is our only business. We are driven by the needs of our clients, not by shareholders. Our vision is to deliver innovative client solutions for a better future.
Our people are passionate, engaged, smart and curious, and we give them the independence and the confidence to make a difference. While we take pride in the excellence of our investment solutions and client service, we know we can always do better. We are honest, respectful and make tough calls, challenging the status quo to achieve better outcomes through innovation. Above all else, we always put our clients first.
About Your Team
The Enterprise Network Security Services team is part of the Enterprise Network & Multimedia Services group, within the Enterprise Infrastructure Services technical division.
The Enterprise Infrastructure Services (EIS) division delivers secure, reliable, and globally accessible IT infrastructure (both on-premises and cloud) supporting Fidelity’s applications, services, and dynamic working environment. The Enterprise Network & Multimedia Services group provides global network connectivity solutions across 60+ office locations, core data centers, and cloud partners. It also delivers multimedia connectivity through telephony and conferencing systems both on-premises and in the cloud. The group aims to ensure resilient, high-performance network and multimedia services company-wide and on a global scale.
The Enterprise Network Security Services team is a dynamic global unit with members across APAC, India, and the UK. It is responsible for the full lifecycle of network security services, covering product strategy, architecture, implementation, operations, and lifecycle governance. The team manages and continuously evolves key security platforms including Palo Alto next-generation firewall technologies and Cisco Secure Workload (CSW) alongside identity-based access control and secure internet access services. Working closely with Cyber Security, Architecture, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams, the group continually enhances Fidelity's security posture through network segmentation, Zero Trust principles, automation, AI-assisted security capabilities, and continuous compliance improvement.
About Your Role
As a Technical Consultant within the Enterprise Network Security Services team, you will play a key role in the design, implementation, governance, and continuous improvement of Fidelity's global network security platforms and services. You will work closely with Engineering teams, Cyber Security, Enterprise Architecture, and business stakeholders to deliver and maintain secure, scalable, and resilient network security solutions.
The role combines deep technical expertise with solution design, project delivery, operational excellence, and technology modernization. You will contribute to strategic initiatives, support major transformation programs, and help evolve the network security portfolio through automation, cloud adoption, zero-trust architectures, and AI-enabled security capabilities.
About You
The ideal candidate brings extensive experience in enterprise network security engineering and architecture, with a proven track record of delivering complex security solutions and supporting large-scale technology transformation initiatives within enterprise environments. Experience within financial services or other highly regulated industries is highly advantageous. You should be comfortable working across architecture, engineering, operations, and project delivery, ensuring security solutions are effectively designed, implemented, and transitioned into service.
You should have strong experience translating business and security requirements into practical technical solutions and operational processes. This includes developing and reviewing solution designs, supporting technology roadmaps, defining technical standards, and ensuring solutions meet requirements for security, resilience, compliance, and operational efficiency. Experience participating in major programs, technology migrations, vendor engagements, and cross-functional delivery projects will be highly valued.
You are expected to demonstrate strong technical expertise across enterprise network security domains, including next-generation firewalls, network segmentation, Zero Trust architectures, identity-based security controls, secure internet access, threat prevention, and security operations. In particular, hands-on experience with Palo Alto next-generation firewalls and Cisco Secure Workload (CSW) or equivalent workload segmentation platforms is highly desirable. The ideal candidate should also possess solid networking fundamentals across routing and switching, data center networking, DNS, load balancing, VPN technologies, and cloud networking, enabling effective design and troubleshooting of end-to-end enterprise solutions. Knowledge of cloud security, security automation, DevOps-aligned practices, AI-assisted security operations, and regulatory frameworks such as the Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) would be advantageous. Strong stakeholder management, analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and the ability to influence technical decisions across multiple teams are essential.
Technical Skills & Experience
Strong hands-on experience supporting and operating enterprise security platforms, particularly Palo Alto next-generation firewalls and Cisco Secure Workload (CSW) or equivalent segmentation technologies.
Proven experience delivering security solutions within large-scale enterprise or hybrid cloud environments.
Experience participating in complex infrastructure transformation, security modernization, or regulatory compliance initiatives.
Good understanding of security automation, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), DevOps practices, and modern operational models.
Professional certifications such as CCNP Security, PCNSE, CISSP, CCIE Security, TOGAF, as well as recognized certifications in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud), DevOps and Infrastructure-as-Code technologies (such as Terraform or Kubernetes), and AI-related technologies are highly desirable.
Responsibilities
In this role, you will contribute to the delivery, operation, and continuous evolution of Fidelity's network security services while supporting strategic initiatives and maintaining operational excellence.
Network Security Solution Design & Engineering
Design, implement, and maintain enterprise network security solutions across on-premises and cloud environments, with particular focus on Palo Alto firewalls, Cisco Secure Workload (CSW), network segmentation, Zero Trust controls, and security policy enforcement.
Develop and review High-Level Designs (HLDs), Low-Level Designs (LLDs), standards, and implementation documentation.
Support security architecture reviews and provide technical guidance on network security best practices.
Contribute to network segmentation, Zero Trust, identity-based access control, and secure connectivity initiatives.
Evaluate emerging technologies and assist with Proof of Concept (PoC) activities and technical assessments.
Project Delivery & Technical Leadership
Participate in major infrastructure and security transformation programs from design through production deployment.
Support end-to-end project delivery activities including requirements gathering, design, testing, implementation, and operational handover.
Coordinate with Product Owners, Engineering teams, and project managers to ensure successful delivery outcomes.
Provide technical leadership for complex changes and support resolution of technical challenges throughout the delivery lifecycle.
Contribute to technology roadmaps and continuous service improvement initiatives.
Operational Excellence & Service Governance
Ensure operational stability, performance, and security of network security platforms and services.
Support incident management, problem management, root-cause analysis, and technical escalations.
Maintain compliance with security policies, regulatory requirements, audit controls, and operational standards.
Support vulnerability remediation, lifecycle management, and platform currency initiatives.
Drive continuous improvement of operational processes, monitoring, alert quality, documentation, and service reliability.
Automation, Innovation & Security Modernization
Promote adoption of automation, Infrastructure-as-Code, and DevOps-aligned practices within network security services.
Support integration of AI-assisted capabilities to improve operational efficiency, threat detection, and service intelligence.
Contribute to cloud security networking initiatives and modernization programs.
Drive improvements in observability, automation maturity, and operational efficiency.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to identify opportunities for innovation and measurable business value from new technologies.
What You'll Participate In During Your First 12 Months
Support delivery of DORA-related network security initiatives, including segmentation, access control, resilience, and security governance improvements.
Contribute to Zero Trust and identity-based segmentation programs across enterprise and cloud environments.
Participate in security modernization initiatives involving firewalls, secure internet access, authentication, and policy governance.
Enhance automation, operational visibility, and security monitoring capabilities to improve service quality and effectiveness.
Build strong working relationships across Global Cyber & Information Security, Enterprise Architecture, Engineering, Product Groups, and key business stakeholders.
Feel rewarded
For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
To assist Area Manager to lead a customer development team in people management, sales performance management, training and coaching, and operational risk control, so as to maximize the productivity of the team and contribute to the achievement of business strategy with high quality sales and service standard.
Closely monitoring the sales and services quality provided by team members so as to ensure the sales/service process is strictly followed and the delivery of a consistently excellent customer experience.
To ensures fair outcomes for customers are delivered in all situations.
To manage, lead and motivate a team of highly mobile sales staff, and to lead a mobile sales team to focus on activities to expand HSBC’s new to wealth acquisition.
Role success will be achieved by focusing on striving to develop new relationships outside HSBC that will deliver sustainable growth and profitability.
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Proven ability in mobile sales
Current product/market knowledge
Excellent customer service skills
Managerial experience
At least 3 years’ experience in supervisory role of sales function
Excellent interpersonal, leadership and motivation skills
Strong sales and organization ability and problem solving skills
Result driven and able to work under pressure
Good spoken and written English
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Assist CGM office on internal communication when required.

Conduct market research on local business potential, considering the strategy and business plans of the branch;
Collate branch level reports for review by Branch Management Committee (Branch MANCO) and Regional Heads, consolidate updates from different Businesses and Functions in the branch;
Organize meetings on behalf of Branch Manager (internal and external, including but not limited to Branch Manco, Risk Session and Regional governance meeting), prepare meeting pack, take meeting minutes and support follow up actions as needed.

Perform KSCA support when required (including but not limited to Panda, Record, Chop), to Support CGM on the robust controls of internal and external

Accountable for implementing and complying with AML and Fraud Prevention requirements when performing duties.

Support presentations to be conducted by the Branch Manager, including drafting presentation content and providing onsite support.
Routinely perform a wide variety of support duties

Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities
Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank

External associations

Good awareness of business trends in the local marketplace and of the Bank’s priorities across Business and Functions.
Strong language skills in both English and Mandarin (verbal and written)

On branch planning

  • Assist in BCP/Business Resilience planning and execution in the branch.

(optional, if the PA providing such local support to HR team, pls keep this item; if not, can be removed).
  • Perform any other tasks assigned by RGM/CGM.

Accountability Review/问责

  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review

  • Local regulators and government officers (if applicable and authorised)

Skills and Experience

  • Solid team player with effective interpersonal and communication skills - able to interact with and engage staff and managers at all levels
  • Able to deliver under tight time pressure, with strong personal drive and willingness to go the extra mile to ensure work is done efficiently together with good quality.
  • Good awareness of business trends in the local marketplace and of the Bank’s priorities across Business and Functions.
  • Strong language skills in both English and Mandarin (verbal and written)
  • Solid computer skills particularly Microsoft Office related software programs.

对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任；

在日常营运工作中，始终遵守与消费者权益保护相关的法规要求，且确保完成相关培训

Responsibilities related to the delivery of business and / or financial objectives, for example, Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates

Key Responsibilities
We are looking for an Investment Research Sector Analyst to join our Equity Research team, with responsibility for covering companies across the Oil, Gas & Chemicals sector.
In this role, you will develop differentiated investment insights through rigorous fundamental analysis of companies, commodities and industry trends. You will combine detailed financial modelling with an understanding of oil, gas, & chemical markets, company strategy, asset quality, capital allocation and valuation to help investors make informed investment decisions.
You will work closely with senior research analysts and colleagues across the broader research platform, while developing relationships with company management teams, investors and industry participants.
Conduct fundamental research on listed Oil, Gas & Chemical companies, including integrated energy companies, exploration and production companies, refiners and other relevant parts of the energy value chain.
Build, maintain and enhance detailed company financial models, including earnings forecasts, cash-flow analysis, balance-sheet analysis and valuation.
Analyze key sector drivers including crude oil and natural gas prices, production volumes, realized pricing, operating costs, capital expenditure, reserve development, refining margins and industry supply-demand dynamics.
Develop investment views at both company and sector level, identifying differentiated insights, catalysts, risks and potential changes in market expectations.
Apply appropriate valuation frameworks, including discounted cash flow, NAV, trading multiples and other sector-relevant methodologies.
Monitor company results, operational updates, commodity-market developments, regulatory changes and geopolitical events, and assess their implications for earnings and valuations.
Contribute to high-quality research publications, including company updates, earnings analysis, industry thematic work and investment strategy pieces.
Engage with corporate management teams and other industry participants to deepen fundamental understanding of companies and market dynamics.
Support discussions with institutional investors by clearly communicating investment theses, industry trends, valuation frameworks and key risks.
Collaborate effectively with research colleagues across sectors, regions and disciplines to develop broader thematic and cross-sector insights.
Maintain high standards of accuracy, intellectual independence, risk awareness and compliance in all research activities.
The team
You'll be working in the Equity Research team in Beijing. We are open and energetic team. We work closely with corporates and clients.
Diversity helps us grow, together. That’s why we are committed to fostering and advancing diversity, equity, and inclusion. It strengthens our business and brings value to our clients.
A successful analyst will combine deep fundamental research, disciplined financial analysis and commercial investment judgement. You will develop a strong understanding of the companies and assets you cover, anticipate changes in earnings and industry fundamentals, and translate those insights into clear and differentiated investment conclusions for institutional investors.
You will also contribute to a collaborative research culture where analytical quality, constructive challenge, integrity and client relevance are central to how the team works.
Your Skills And Experience
You have:
Strong experience in equity research, investment analysis, asset management, investment banking, corporate finance, consulting or a relevant Oil, Gas & Chemical industry role.
A strong understanding of financial statements, corporate finance, accounting and equity valuation.
Demonstrated ability to build and interpret detailed financial models and translate analysis into actionable investment conclusions.
Knowledge of the Oil, Gas & Chemical industry and its key operational and financial drivers. Experience covering energy companies is highly desirable.
Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to identify the variables that matter most to earnings, cash flow and valuation.
Intellectual curiosity and the ability to develop independent, evidence-based investment views rather than simply describe industry developments.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex industry and financial issues clearly and concisely.
Ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving environment, particularly during earnings seasons and periods of commodity or market volatility.
Strong attention to detail, sound judgement and a collaborative working style.
